verdict.rationale: Stripe documents creating FinancialAccounts through its API (the `money_manager` configuration plus a financial address for funding), and platform-owned controls for account onboarding, so programmatic account provisioning is a first-party capability. The pack does not show that these accounts are insured deposit accounts, that the application-to-active path (including KYC/approval) is fully automated, or that a sandbox matches live behavior. missing for 10: evidence of deposit insurance, documented end-to-end programmatic application-to-activation flow, sandbox/test-mode parity for the onboarding flow, independent hands-on corroboration.
